name: Microsoft OneDrive
label: Microsoft Graph Files (OneDrive)
description: Microsoft Graph Files (OneDrive) via OfficialApiNode (nodes/microsoft-onedrive/api_spec.json). Canonical OneDrive node (also listed under Files & Documents — one node). Official Graph driveItem. Chunked upload >4 MiB uses createUploadSession (upload session URL is returned in data). Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/drive?view=graph-rest-1.0. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Microsoft OneDrive official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"copy"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'copy', 'delete', 'download', 'get', 'rename', 'search', 'share', 'upload', 'create_folder', 'list_children', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'copy'.

schema.label: name
schema.description: New name for rename / copy, or folder name for create_folder. Example: Q1.xlsx.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Search query for search GET /me/drive/root/search(q='{q}'). Example: invoice.

schema.label: type
schema.description: createLink type for share. EXACT: view | edit | embed. Example: view.

schema.label: scope
schema.description: createLink scope for share. EXACT: anonymous | organization. Example: organization.

schema.label: filename
schema.description: Server-relative path for upload. Example: Documents/notes.txt.

schema.label: file
schema.description: File bytes for upload. Platform file list. Sent as the raw PUT body to /me/drive/root:/{filename}:/content.

schema.label: parent_id
schema.description: Parent folder item id for create_folder. Use root item id for the drive root.

schema.label: folder
schema.description: create_folder: empty object {} marks a folder (official Graph). Example: {}.

schema.label: @microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior
schema.description: create_folder conflict behavior. EXACT: fail | replace | rename. Example: rename.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: copy, delete, download, get, rename, search, share, upload, create_folder, list_children, listen. Default: copy. Example: copy.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
